summary: X-Plane entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: X-Plane
entries.definitive_edition: Current X-Plane 12 desktop build with exact version and add-ons documented

emulation.notes: Use native desktop build with documented hardware controls and add-ons.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current desktop X-Plane build on calibrated hardware, with version/add-on state documented

primary.why: X-Plane is a long-running simulator rather than a fixed one-and-done game. The current X-Plane 12 desktop build is the practical primary route because it is actively maintained, runs on desktop platforms, and incorporates the latest official flight-model, weather, scenery, aircraft, and performance updates.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current X-Plane 12 desktop build. Record exact version, storefront, OS, graphics settings, scenery/add-ons, aircraft, hardware controls, VR/head tracking, navdata, weather source, flight plan, and whether an older X-Plane version was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Historical flight-model, scenery, UI, aircraft, and add-on compatibility states
secondary.what_to_play: Use only when documenting a dated version or add-on ecosystem.
secondary.why: The current X-Plane 12 route is the main maintained desktop simulator.
Desktop has the strongest fidelity, controls, and add-on ecosystem.

entries.remaster_caveats: Recheck version before every archive run; X-Plane is updated continuously and older add-ons may not behave the same.
